_comment: Each rail replacement bus stop, by its what3words address on Southern's poster: the poster's words, and a position placed by hand from the poster's map (position_basis says how). Read by scripts/fetch_rail_replacement.py, which checks each address is still on the station's current poster.

upper.herb.frog.name: Turning circle on Stroudley Road
upper.herb.frog.position_basis: The poster places the stop by what3words only. This is FlixBus's Brighton stop on the same turning circle (9000F22A3795 in the timetable), which matches the poster's map.
